$comment: sherpa-onnx C API runtime pack (CPU tier: streaming / utterance ASR, Kokoro / Kitten / Piper TTS with C espeak-ng, spoken language ID, speaker embeddings), loaded in-process by speech_rt::sherpa through libloading. Owned by P1-G1; decision record docs/adr/0002-sherpa-onnx.md.

Official k2-fsa release asset of tag v1.13.8 (2026-09-10): the Windows x64 shared, static-CRT (/MT) Release build, '-lib' variant (DLLs + import libs only). Size and sha256 are GitHub's asset digest; the archive was downloaded and re-hashed locally (b8eedf41...).

Only onnxruntime.dll (ONNX Runtime 1.28.2, CPU) and sherpa-onnx-c-api.dll are installed. No execution-provider DLLs: sherpa's ORT stays CPU-only; Sigil's own statically linked ORT owns every GPU session.

Upgrade: bump version and the pin together, regenerate bindings (scripts/runtime-packs/sherpa/gen-bindings.ps1), bump EXPECTED_VERSION in speech_rt/sherpa/lib.rs, and re-run the ADR 0002 probe matrix.

entries.title: sherpa-onnx speech runtime (CPU)
entries.description: Runs local speech recognition (Nemotron, SenseVoice, Qwen3-ASR, Parakeet, Moonshine) and Kokoro / Kitten / Piper voices on the processor. About 22 MB installed.
